Make the prediction grid

Author

Max Lindmark

Published

2025-03-18

Intro

Make an evenly spaced UTM prediction grid with all spatially varying covariates for the diet and the biomass data

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyterra)
library(tidylog)
library(sp)
library(raster)
Warning: package 'raster' was built under R version 4.3.3
library(devtools)
library(RCurl)
library(sdmTMB)
library(terra)
Warning: package 'terra' was built under R version 4.3.3
library(ncdf4)
library(chron)
library(ggsidekick)
theme_set(theme_sleek())

# Set path
home <- here::here()

Read data and depth-raster

d <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/cpue_length.csv"))

Make the grid with depth

First make a grid for the biomass data, then subset that based on the extend of the stomach data

x <- d$X
y <- d$Y
z <- chull(x, y)

coords <- cbind(x[z], y[z])

coords <- rbind(coords, coords[1, ])

plot(coords[, 1] ~ coords[, 2]) # plot data
sp_poly <- sp::SpatialPolygons(
  list(sp::Polygons(list(sp::Polygon(coords)), ID = 1))
  )

sp_poly_df <- sp::SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(sp_poly,
                                           data = data.frame(ID = 1)
                                           )
cell_width <- 3

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  X = seq(min(d$X), max(d$X), cell_width),
  Y = seq(min(d$Y), max(d$Y), cell_width),
  year = sort(unique(d$year))
  )

sp::coordinates(pred_grid) <- c("X", "Y")

inside <- !is.na(sp::over(pred_grid, as(sp_poly_df, "SpatialPolygons")))

pred_grid <- pred_grid[inside, ]

pred_grid <- as.data.frame(pred_grid)

ggplot(data = filter(pred_grid, year == 1999), aes(X*1000, Y*1000)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.001, alpha = 0.5) +
  NULL
filter: removed 955,305 rows (98%), 21,229 rows remaining
# Add lat and lon
# Need to go from UTM to lat long for this one...
# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/30018098/how-to-convert-utm-coordinates-to-lat-and-long-in-r
xy <- as.matrix(pred_grid |> dplyr::select(X, Y) |> mutate(X = X*1000, Y = Y*1000))
mutate: changed 976,534 values (100%) of 'X' (0 new NA)
        changed 976,534 values (100%) of 'Y' (0 new NA)
v <- vect(xy, crs="+proj=utm +zone=33 +datum=WGS84  +units=m")
y <- project(v, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
lonlat <- geom(y)[, c("x", "y")]

pred_grid$lon <- lonlat[, 1]
pred_grid$lat <- lonlat[, 2]

ggplot(filter(pred_grid, year == 1999), aes(lon, lat)) + geom_point()
filter: removed 955,305 rows (98%), 21,229 rows remaining
# Add depth now to remove islands and remaining land
dep_raster <- terra::rast("/Users/maxlindmark/Dropbox/Max work/R/pred-prey-overlap/data/covariates/depth/Mean depth natural colour (with land).nc")

pred_grid$depth <- terra::extract(dep_raster, pred_grid |> dplyr::select(lon, lat))$elevation*-1

pred_grid <- pred_grid |> drop_na(depth)
drop_na: removed 185,242 rows (19%), 791,292 rows remaining
pred_grid |> 
  filter(year == 1999) |> 
  drop_na(depth) |> 
  ggplot(aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = depth)) + 
  geom_raster() +
  NULL
filter: removed 774,090 rows (98%), 17,202 rows remaining
drop_na: no rows removed

Add month_year variable for matching with raster layers

pred_grid <- pred_grid |>
  replicate_df(time_name = "month", time_values = c(2, 11)) |> 
  mutate(quarter = ifelse(month == 2, 1, 4))
mutate: new variable 'quarter' (double) with 2 unique values and 0% NA

Add environmental variables

env_vars <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/covariates/bias_corr_vars.csv"))
Rows: 7534800 Columns: 7
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
dbl (7): lon, lat, year, month, oxy, temp, sal

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
# Loop through all year-month combos, extract the variables at data locations
d_list <- list()

pred_grid$year_month <- paste(pred_grid$year, pred_grid$month, sep = "_")
env_vars$year_month <- paste(env_vars$year, env_vars$month, sep = "_")

for (i in sort(unique(pred_grid$year_month))) {

  d_sub <- filter(pred_grid, year_month == i)
  env_sub <- filter(env_vars, year_month == i)

  # Convert to spat_raster
  env_raster <- as_spatraster(env_sub,
    xycols = 1:2,
    crs = "WGS84", digits = 3
  )

  # Extract from raster
  d_sub <- d_sub |> 
    mutate(temp = terra::extract(env_raster$temp, d_sub |> dplyr::select(lon, lat))$temp,
           sal = terra::extract(env_raster$sal, d_sub |> dplyr::select(lon, lat))$sal,
           oxy = terra::extract(env_raster$oxy, d_sub |> dplyr::select(lon, lat))$oxy)
  
  # Save
  d_list[[i]] <- d_sub
}
